title: Tori project config
description: What this repo proposes for the worktrees Tori makes of it, at <worktree>/.tori/project.json. Nothing in it runs until the user accepts this exact content, and a value the user set in Tori wins over it.

setupCommand.description: Setup command. Runs with sh -c in each new worktree, with TORI_PROJECT_ROOT and TORI_WORKTREE_PATH set.

runCommand.description: Run command. Started and stopped by hand from a worktree's row, a dev server usually, with TORI_PORT set.

teardownCommand.description: Teardown command. Runs with sh -c before a worktree is removed. The removal goes ahead if it fails or runs past 2 minutes.

ports.description: Ports per worktree. How many of each worktree's block of 10 ports are exported as TORI_PORT, TORI_PORT_1 and on.

checks.description: Verification commands. A turn that changed code is verified when the last of these it ran after its last edit passed.
